record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Jonathelemrechokim<WH03128>, Michtam<WH04387> of David<WH01732>, when the Philistines<WH06430> took<WH0270><WTH8800> him in Gath<WH01661>.<Fo><Fo> Be merciful<WH02603><WTH8798> unto me, O God<WH0430>: for man<WH0582> would swallow me up<WH07602><WTH8804>; he fighting<WH03898><WTH8802> daily<WH03117> oppresseth<WH03905><WTH8799> me. <RF>Michtam...: or, A golden Psalm of David<Rf>

Mine enemies<WH08324><WTH8802> would daily<WH03117> swallow<WH07602><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> up: for <FI>they be<Fi> many<WH07227> that fight<WH03898><WTH8802> against me, O thou most High<WH04791>. <RF>enemies: Heb. observers<Rf>
What time<WH03117> I am afraid<WH03372><WTH8799>, I will trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in thee.

In God<WH0430> I will praise<WH01984><WTH8762> his word<WH01697>, in God<WH0430> I have put my trust<WH0982><WTH8804>; I will not fear<WH03372><WTH8799> what flesh<WH01320> can do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto me.
Every day<WH03117> they wrest<WH06087><WTH8762> my words<WH01697>: all their thoughts<WH04284> <FI>are<Fi> against me for evil<WH07451>.

They gather themselves together<WH01481><WTH8799>, they hide<WH06845><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH06845><WTH8686> themselves, they mark<WH08104><WTH8799> my steps<WH06119>, when they wait<WH06960><WTH8765> for my soul<WH05315>.
Shall they escape<WH06405> by iniquity<WH0205>? in <FI>thine<Fi> anger<WH0639> cast down<WH03381><WTH8685> the people<WH05971>, O God<WH0430>.<CM>
Thou tellest<WH05608><WTH8804> my wanderings<WH05112>: put<WH07760><WTH8798> thou my tears<WH01832> into thy bottle<WH04997>: <FI>are they<Fi> not in thy book<WH05612>?

When<WH03117> I cry<WH07121><WTH8799> <FI>unto thee<Fi> , then shall mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> turn<WH07725><WTH8799> back<WH0268>: this I know<WH03045><WTH8804>; for God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> for me.
In God<WH0430> will I praise<WH01984><WTH8762> <FI>his<Fi> word<WH01697>: in the LORD<WH03068> will I praise<WH01984><WTH8762> <FI>his<Fi> word<WH01697>.
In God<WH0430> have I put my trust<WH0982><WTH8804>: I will not be afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> what man<WH0120> can do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto me.
Thy vows<WH05088> <FI>are<Fi> upon me, O God<WH0430>: I will render<WH07999><WTH8762> praises<WH08426> unto thee.

For thou hast delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> my soul<WH05315> from death<WH04194>: <FI>wilt<Fi> not <FI>thou deliver<Fi> my feet<WH07272> from falling<WH01762>, that I may walk<WH01980><WTH8692> before<WH06440> God<WH0430> in the light<WH0216> of the living<WH02416>?<CM>
